currentParagraphText: “You’ll see for yourself soon. All I can say is that they grow quickly when this young. Too quickly for my liking at times,” Caleb just smiled, his tone a lot different when he spoke about family compared to work.

finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Sounds nice, I guess,” Jake nodded, though he definitely wouldn’t trade a nice home for having to do paperwork. “Say, how are Adam and Maja?”
